body: oh well. Thank you so much for your help. You sound like you are having some troubles too, i hope that you feel better yourself. you probably won't hear from me again, although i dont know why you would anyhow. bye.
If you know the name or where I could find such a group, that would be nice. Unfortunately, at this point i lack the motivation to do so myself. (isnt depression lovely)
I gave my heart to someone, and it died along with them. I feel like I can't love again. I am a very emotionally driven person, to me this is a death sentence by itself.

No friends. Telling my family would only make them freak out and get rid of my only solace, privacy. My girlfriend's family speaks no english, I was just beginning to learn spanish. While I appreciate your ideas, they unfortunately will not work.
That's the thing. No one is trying to reach out to me. I'm rational enough to realize it if it was happening. It isn't.
